settings.no_merge_renderer: Rooms aren't drawn into the world with this renderer (see [Render] sBackend in SeamlessSkyrim.ini).
settings.enabled_unavailable: Off for this session: set bEnabled=1 under [Portals] in SeamlessSkyrim.ini and restart the game.
settings.enabled_session: For this session; to keep it off, set bEnabled=0 in SeamlessSkyrim.ini.
settings.merge: Draw rooms into the world (seen from outside)
settings.shown_rooms_help: Outdoors, the rooms behind the nearest doors are loaded, so a doorway opens at once when you walk up, and each open door shows its own room. Counts the room you're at; 1 = only that one. Each costs memory, a short frame when it loads, frame time while its doorway is on screen, and its people are simulated.
settings.shown_rooms_one_at_a_time: This renderer draws one room at a time: the others stay loaded out of sight, and their open doors show a picture.
settings.pause_unseen_help: A loaded room whose doorway is out of view isn't simulated or drawn until it comes into view; the room at the door you're at always runs.
settings.step_exterior: Street physics while indoors (people outside walk)
settings.doors_help: A door opens when you or someone else uses it, and shuts a few seconds after nobody stands in it. City gates and doors set to always open stand open. All shut: those too stay shut until used.
settings.door_reach_help: The space behind a door starts loading 300 units beyond this and is let go 700 units beyond it.
settings.picture_size_help: The blurred picture a doorway shows while the space behind it loads, in texels across the doorway. Larger is sharper; each door is taken again at the new size when next seen open (doors to the outdoors keep one per part of the day, of the doorway only: a 25th of the size).
settings.delete_pictures_help: Each door shows the plain colour until it is next seen open, and is taken again then.
door.none: Walk up to a door: its doorway's settings appear here.
door.portal: Seamless door (off: an ordinary door with a loading screen)
door.opens_inward: Opens inward (off: outward, into the street)
door.always_open: Always open (not only when used; once its doorway has a picture)
door.picture_from_afar: Plain colour until it has a picture (a gate walled up behind)
door.turn_help: If the room behind the doorway doesn't line up with the outside, turn it here. It follows the slider live.
door.shift_help: Move the inside against the outside (game units; sideways and further in as seen walking in):
